title: Make TravvyC the only admin and enforce unique usernames at account creation

requirements.text: Update the app’s username/password auth so the ONLY admin is the account whose username is exactly "TravvyC"; no other username may ever have admin access, even if localStorage contains an old/stale `isAdmin` flag.

quotes: Yes TravvyC should be the only admin regardless

acceptanceCriteria: When signed in as username "TravvyC", the session/auth context `isAdmin` is true and the Admin link is visible in the header.
When signed in as any username other than "TravvyC", the session/auth context `isAdmin` is false and the Admin link is not visible.
Attempting to navigate to /admin while signed in as any username other than "TravvyC" shows the existing "Access Denied" state (AdminGate).
Changing any stored user record (e.g., `rf_falcon_users`) to include `isAdmin: true` does not grant admin access unless the signed-in username is "TravvyC".

requirements.text: Enforce unique usernames during sign-up and block duplicate usernames from being created, showing a clear error in English when a duplicate is attempted.

quotes: don’t let duplicate usernames when people are creating accounts
and the answer to number three is yes

acceptanceCriteria: If a user attempts to sign up with a username that already exists, sign-up fails and shows an error message (e.g., "Username already exists").
A successful sign-up persists the new user such that a second sign-up attempt with the same username is rejected.
The duplicate-username check is applied consistently with the exact same username string the system stores/uses for sign-in.

requirements.text: Ensure the admin determination is applied consistently across sign-up, sign-in, and session restore (loading an existing session from localStorage) so that a previously-created "TravvyC" account becomes admin after this change without requiring manual data edits.

quotes: OK, I created my account, but it did not make me a admin

acceptanceCriteria: If localStorage already contains a valid session for username "TravvyC", reloading the page results in `isAdmin === true` and access to /admin is allowed.
If localStorage already contains a valid session for a non-"TravvyC" username (even if the stored session has `isAdmin: true`), reloading the page results in `isAdmin === false` and /admin is denied.
If localStorage contains user records created before this change, signing in as "TravvyC" still yields admin access after credential verification.

constraints: Do not edit files in frontend/immutablePaths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Implementing backend-backed username/password authentication in Motoko (this change only adjusts the existing frontend session/localStorage auth behavior).
Adding additional admin accounts or role management UI beyond the single fixed admin username "TravvyC".
